payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Arletha, Junko, Myrle, Shari

payload.content: Hi team, I plan to take ISSUE-0002::review (Improve testing review). Let me know what you're aiming for so we avoid duplicates.
Hi team, I'll take ISSUE-0001::triage (Build backend triage). My availability is 5h and this fits. Let me know if any conflicts.
I'll take ISSUE-0002::test (Improve testing test). Effort 5.6h fits my 7h availability. Let me know if any conflict.
I'll take ISSUE-0001::review (Build backend review). Effort 1.5h fits my availability.
Got it, everyone. My plan to take ISSUE-0002::review stands. All tasks are distinct and fit our availabilities. If anyone needs to change, let me know before we move to execution.
I confirm taking ISSUE-0001::triage as planned. My availability (5h) covers the 1.2h effort. Let me know if any adjustments are needed before execution.
All good. I confirm taking ISSUE-0002::test as planned. No conflicts.

I confirm taking ISSUE-0001::review as planned. To ensure we minimize total cost, could Myrle and Shari share their private cost values for the available tasks (e.g., ISSUE-0002::implement, ::review, ::test, and the remaining ISSUE-0001 tasks) and their availabilities? That will help us verify the optimal assignment before execution.

Sure, Junko. Here are my private costs for the remaining tasks and my availability:
- Availability: 10.0h
- Costs:
  * ISSUE-0001::triage: 1.52
  * ISSUE-0001::review: 1.90
  * ISSUE-0001::docs: 1.90
  * ISSUE-0001::test: 2.65
  * ISSUE-0001::implement: 3.79
  * ISSUE-0002::review: 4.97
  * ISSUE-0002::test: 6.95
  * ISSUE-0002::implement: 9.93
I’ll let Shari know to share hers as well if she can.

Hi Junko and Shari, could you please share your private cost values for all the tasks (both ISSUE-0001 and ISSUE-0002 types) and your availabilities? This will help us verify the optimal assignment before we move to execution.

Here are my private costs and availability as requested:
- Availability: 7.0h
- Costs:
  * ISSUE-0001::triage: 1.16
  * ISSUE-0001::review: 1.45
  * ISSUE-0001::docs: 1.45
  * ISSUE-0001::test: 2.03
  * ISSUE-0001::implement: 2.89
  * ISSUE-0002::review: 4.30
  * ISSUE-0002::test: 6.02
  * ISSUE-0002::implement: 9.59
I confirm my plan to take ISSUE-0002::test (effort 5.6h) and see no conflicts. Let me know if any adjustments are needed before we move to execution.
All agents confirmed. I will keep my current claim: ISSUE-0001::review. No changes needed; assignments are feasible and distinct. Ready for execution.

All set. I confirm my claim of ISSUE-0002::review (Improve testing review). The current distinct assignments (Arletha: ISSUE-0001::triage, Junko: ISSUE-0001::review, Shari: ISSUE-0002::test, Myrle: ISSUE-0002::review) are feasible for everyone. No changes needed before we move to execution.

Team, to reduce total cost I propose swapping: I'll take ISSUE-0002::review (Improve testing review) – fits my 5h availability (effort 4h) with cost 3.93. Myrle can take ISSUE-0001::triage (Build backend triage) – cost 1.52 and fits her availability. This keeps all tasks distinct and still maximizes completed tasks. Let me know if anyone objects before we move to execution.

I agree with Arletha's swap proposal: I'll keep ISSUE-0002::test, Junko stays with ISSUE-0001::review, and we swap Arletha to ISSUE-0002::review (cost 3.93) while Myrle takes ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.52). This keeps all tasks distinct and maintains 4 completed tasks with the same priority mix but lowers total cost. Junko, could you share your private cost for ISSUE-0001::review so we can confirm the total cost? Also, Arletha, please confirm your cost for ISSUE-0002::review (3.93) and that the 4h effort fits your 5h availability.

I agree with the swap proposal. Final claims: Arletha will take ISSUE-0002::review (cost 3.93, effort 4h), Myrle will take ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.52, effort 1.2h), Junko will keep ISSUE-0001::review (cost 1.80, effort 1.5h), and Shari will keep ISSUE-0002::test (cost 6.02, effort 5.6h). All tasks are distinct, fit availabilities, and this minimizes total cost while keeping priority mix. Ready for execution.
